messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticed a burst of short-lived SSE sessions on route 'streaming-annotations' in ap-northeast around 04:12 UTC. Console shows reconnect spikes and a small billing bump. Anyone seeing this in canary?

oliver: saw the console alert. pattern looks like repeated 204 + immediate client reconnects. we flipped resume_behavior flag in the rollout at ~04:05.

raj: logs look like: ```
[04:12:02] proxy: route=streaming-annotations status=204 resume_ttl=0ms conn=7742 closed by upstream
[04:12:02] client-sdk: reconnect attempt=1 backoff=0s
[04:12:03] billing: session.create token=tok_99 id=evt_3002
```

maya: resume_ttl=0ms is the giveaway. that change was intended to accelerate failover but ends up tombstoning sessions instantly.

oliver: infra-bot: show session.create delta for that route?

infra-bot: [automated] session.create rate for "streaming-annotations" increased 3.0x between 04:10 and 04:14 UTC. unique tokens with >1 create increased from 18 to 96.

raj: immediate mitigations: 1) rollback resume_behavior in canary (i'm doing it) 2) server-side soft-204 debounce (250ms) to prevent immediate re-create storms 3) add billing idempotency keyed by token+short-window.

maya: agree server fixes first — many clients won't patch fast. console-bot: can we add a reconnect-rate heatmap + annotate with recent flag flips in the topology view? that would've cut triage time.

console-bot: [automated] UX idea captured: reconnect-rate heatmap + flag-overlay. Ticket CON-3050 created.

oliver: billing-bot: can billing accept an idempotency key on session.create?

billing-bot: [automated] yes. billing service supports X-Session-Id dedupe for duplicates within 3s. Feature flag BILLING-DEDUPE ready for rollout.

raj: i'll open a small PR for server debounce + an integration test that simulates repeated 204->immediate reconnect loop. will tag maya for review.

maya: please also add an alert: reconnect-rate > baseline*2 AND recent-flag-change within 10m -> page eng-oncall with top-10 affected tokens. that would've surfaced this earlier.

oliver: devex: add a short note in streaming quickstart: "Treat 204/early-close as transient; implement exponential backoff + jitter."

maya: revert complete at 04:19 UTC, metrics trending down. follow-ups: server debounce (raj), billing dedupe (niranjan), console overlay + alert (josh), docs blurb (devex). scheduling a 30m post-incident sync. :white_check_mark:
